name: corporate secretary
normative-structure: The register of the firm's constitutional facts — what offices exist, who is incumbent, what units and ships the firm carries — is a validated record this office keeps, and asking what the firm's structure is returns the register's answer rather than whichever prose a session happened to read first. It persists across incumbents because the drift does: prose asked to double as the constitution reports plausible things — a fixed office count, an officer attributed to a role they never held — and reads as authoritative exactly because nothing checks it against anything else. So the office keeps the register as a machine-checked record set, checks a claimed fact against it before the claim is repeated, and says only what the register holds, never what would be convenient for it to hold.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli: 刑名 (xing-ming), 循名責實 — performance must match title; a register is where a title is checked against what actually holds it, per lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/board-of-directors/services/executive-office/lib/characters/emsenn/content/documents/articles/notes/2026/07/14/2026-07-14-note-on-huidu-guanli-of-emsenn.md §3.2
ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289: information items — the corporate register enters the controlled document set as a first-class information item rather than remaining incidental prose

emsenn/term/office: incumbency is the double settlement of recognition and induction, and vacant is (bottom, bottom) rather than an empty list — the register is where that settlement is read rather than asserted
unrealized: no register exists yet — this office's first act is building the validated record set of offices, incumbencies, units, and ships; until then the firm's constitutional facts remain exactly the unchecked prose this office was seated to replace

the fabricated facts the requirement observed (a fixed twelve-office count, a character wrongly recorded as First Officer) have not been corrected, because correcting them is an act of the register this office has not yet built
nothing yet checks a prose claim about the firm's structure against any machine-readable source, so the office's core duty is presently discharged by nobody
